subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: After acceptable real Microsoft Teams proof is attached, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 be the canonical implementation?
rationale: Both branches address the same missing hook; this PR has stronger shared-delivery coverage and avoids exporting the private adapter, while the older branch is smaller, so repository ownership must choose one landing path.

options.title: Prefer this PR
options.body: Keep this branch as canonical because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline and avoids expanding the adapter export surface, then close the overlapping PR after real proof is added.

options.title: Prefer the older PR
options.body: Use the smaller older branch as canonical, port any desired delivery-boundary coverage into it, and close this PR only after the replacement has sufficient real proof.

recommendation.title: Prefer this PR
recommendation.body: Keep this branch as canonical because it exercises the shared delivery pipeline and avoids expanding the adapter export surface, then close the overlapping PR after real proof is added.
